info.title: Hien’s Nha local backend API
info.description: Local Phases 1–4, production sources remain Git; no production cutover. PR35 prepared admission: Edge HTTP routes/DTOs remain unchanged. Proposed DB/Edge pair uses caller-scoped metered POST RPCs and denies direct content-table SELECT/GET RPC bypass. Shared RPC caps are application protection, not gateway/WAF or failed-request/egress coverage. Not yet deployed.

Comment.description: ADR0014: authenticated new comments/replies are immediately approved. Author edits to hidden/rejected comments retain moderation. Existing pending records are not bulk-published; status enum and API/RPC signatures remain compatible.
